stories.title: Trump orders the Army not to detonate hazardous chemicals in Iowa without court approval
stories.summary: The Army has changed the date for the planned detonation of 68 barrels of lead azide three times following an outpouring of public concern about potential health and environmental effects.

stories.title: Brisk bidding in Alaska oil lease sales dominated by a single company
stories.summary: Texas-based APA Corp., which is expanding its Alaska operations, won most of the tracts that drew bids in two state auctions for onshore and offshore territory.

stories.title: For Netanyahu, losing power could mean losing a key shield in corruption trial
stories.summary: Out of office, the longtime Israeli leader would have to contest a criminal trial and other legal problems without the power of the prime minister’s post.

stories.title: GOP leaders signal openness to cutting off Iran war funding as shutdown inches closer
stories.summary: With a Dec. 11 shutdown looming, key Republicans say they are willing to consider Democrats’ demand to fund the Pentagon but starve the unpopular war.

stories.title: Airline glitches and storms could make for a messy Thanksgiving travel week
stories.summary: The biggest unknown for travelers is whether airlines will be upended again by new system failures.

stories.title: Indonesian rescuers race to find 34 missing workers after deadly fire at candy factory
stories.summary: About 300 workers were inside when the fire erupted. Many escaped, and rescuers saved 29 workers, five of whom were hospitalized.

stories.title: Judge sentences man to serve 20 years in 2022 South Anchorage teen murder
stories.summary: The fatal shooting of 16-year-old Jersey Miller occurred in the Abbott Loop neighborhood. The shooter and two others involved were all teenagers.

stories.title: States sue Musk companies over flood of sexualized images made with AI chatbot Grok
stories.summary: Virginia and Oregon argue in lawsuits filed Monday that Musk’s companies disregarded safety while building and rolling out the chatbot Grok in ways that allowed proliferation of harmful sexualized imagery, including child abuse material.

stories.title: Jensen Huang went to war with Washington — and won a path to China
stories.summary: The Nvidia founder wooed the president and pushed back against lawmakers as the company sought a foothold in the vast Chinese market. The tactics left a trail of mistrust.

stories.title: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: The announcement is the latest twist in the fallout from Huang’s admission of an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

stories.title: Miss Manners: Is it OK to withhold gratuity because of poor service?
stories.summary: Advice from Judith Martin, Nicholas Ivor Martin and Jacobina Martin.

stories.title: Brock Purdy carves up the Vikings’ D with 3 TD passes in 49ers’ win in Mexico City
stories.summary: Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers offense turned the much ballyhooed matchup between one of the game’s top offenses against the stingiest defenses a one-sided affair.
